title: Store Settings
description: Store-local configuration (Store.settings). All flows default to false.

requireAcceptance.description: When true, Trade confirm waits for the Store acceptance fact; StoreOrder stays pending until staff accept (or inventory confirms when requireInventory is also true). Default false (worker auto-accepts).

requireInventory.description: When true, StoreOrder awaits an inventory reservation before acceptance. Default false (no reservation requested).

requireVerification.description: When true, a fulfilled Store order must be verified before it can be completed.
